evidence: From the car park follow the rough farm road down to river level, then pick up the orange triangular markers and follow these across the open flats to the bush line and the start of the track.
Turn off the Kokatahi/Lake Kaniere circuit road at the signpost 'Access to Toaroha Valley', cross the bridge over the Kokatahi River and follow the road as far as your vehicle will allow.
The route then travels downstream on the true left of the Styx River. The Styx is crossed again to and an old farm track leads to the carpark at the Lake Kaniere Road.

doubts: Start: the text names no road. F2 (an unnamed track meeting Middlebranch Road) is the only road-end feature that fits a car park reached by the road over the Kokatahi bridge, but the text does not name it, so the ref is likely rather than certain. F1 is at the Cedar Flat Bridge, not a road end. End: no feature for the car park at Lake Kaniere Road, so null. The route crosses the Toaroha Range ridgeline about 500 m north of Zit Saddle, so Zit Saddle is not walked. The Kokatahi is crossed (recorded once as a ford; the text says it is crossed three times). The cableway, Top Kokatahi swing bridge, Cedar Flat Bridge and the Visitor-free stream crossings are recorded as the page names them; unnamed creeks are not listed. The text does not say whether the Tyndall Creek and Styx River crossings in the final section are fords as such; they are recorded as fords because the text says to cross them. Grassy Flats Hut has no link and no map name, so ref is null. The alternative Arahura Track is not a way of this walk, so it is only not_on_route.
